items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Played drums. And we just played and played and played.

ctx.x: Played drums. And we just played and played and played. The only time we stopped was when Bix wanted to play a little piano. And I'm amazed, how much he played.

Now, the funny thing, my reaction then was that I liked Wingie better than Bix, in person, because Wingie swung harder and he just made me feel like the music was moving. Bix, -- now that I listen to Bix, Bix had so many beautiful ideas, but it had very little to do with moving me rhythmically or anything.
